description: Excalibur Pack Catalog — certified adversary emulation packs for Morgana. Each pack targets a specific MITRE ATT&CK tactic or domain, with tested scripts and detection goals validated against Microsoft Sentinel built-in analytics rules.

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for Microsoft Entra ID detection validation. 23 scripts covering identity attacks: group manipulation, privileged role assignment, PIM abuse, consent phishing, MFA bypass, sign-in anomalies. Validated against Microsoft Sentinel Entra ID analytics rules.
prerequisites: Microsoft Graph PowerShell module v2.37+
Azure App Registration with Graph permissions
Entra ID P2 license (for PIM scripts)

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Execution tactic (TA0002). 12 scripts covering all scriptable parent techniques: WMI, Scheduled Task, PowerShell -EncodedCommand, Software Deployment LOLBin, Native API P/Invoke, Shared Modules, User Execution, COM Objects, System Services, Reflective Code Loading, Azure Automation Runbook, Azure VM Run Command.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
Windows Security Events via AMA connector in Sentinel

packs.description: General-purpose utility scripts for Morgana. Sleep/wait helper, directory listing test, and PowerShell parameter-passing test. Use these to validate agent connectivity and tag substitution before running adversary emulation packs.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Persistence tactic (TA0003). 10 scripts covering all scriptable parent techniques: Logon Script (registry), Scheduled Task persistence (AtLogon trigger), Account Manipulation, Create Account, BITS Jobs, Create System Process (Automatic service), WMI Event Subscription, Registry Run Key, DLL Search Order Hijack, Web Shell. Validates Microsoft Sentinel built-in rules and MDE behavioral detections.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
Windows Security Events via AMA connector in Sentinel (Event IDs 4698, 4720, 4732, 5861, 7045)
Local Administrator privileges required for T1098, T1136, T1543, T1546

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Credential Access tactic (TA0006). 10 scripts: LSASS dump (comsvcs.dll), network sniffing (netsh trace), input capture (GetAsyncKeyState), brute force (LogonUser API → Event ID 4625), forced authentication (UNC .url lure), application token theft, web session cookie enumeration, unsecured credential search, password store enumeration (cmdkey + DPAPI), Kerberoasting SPN LDAP enumeration.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
Windows Security Events via AMA connector in Sentinel (Event IDs 4625, 4648)
Administrator required for T1003 and T1040
Domain-joined machine required for T1558 (Kerberoasting)

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Discovery tactic (TA0007). 10 scripts: service enumeration (sc.exe/wmic), registry query (reg.exe), network configuration (ipconfig/route/nslookup), remote system discovery (ARP/ping sweep/nbtstat), network connections (netstat), process discovery (tasklist/wmic), permission groups (net localgroup/LDAP), system information (systeminfo), account discovery (net user/LDAP), network share discovery (net share/net view). All scripts read-only, no Admin required.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
No Administrator privileges required
Domain-joined machine for LDAP steps in T1069 and T1087 (optional - scripts fail gracefully)

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Defense Evasion tactic (TA0005). 10 scripts: obfuscated payload execution (base64), masquerading (renamed binary), process injection API pattern (OpenProcess+VirtualAllocEx), event log clearing (wevtutil), Defender policy registry modification, LOLBin proxy execution (mshta+rundll32+regsvr32), XSL script processing (wmic /format), sandbox evasion checks, impair defenses (Set-MpPreference), NTFS Alternate Data Stream hiding.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
Administrator required for T1070, T1112, T1562
Windows Security Events via AMA connector in Sentinel (Event IDs 1102, 4719)

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Lateral Movement tactic (TA0008). 10 scripts targeting a configurable remote host: RDP (mstsc.exe), SMB admin share (net use C$), WinRM remote execution (Invoke-Command), SSH (ssh.exe), WMI remote (wmic /node:), Pass-the-Hash simulation (LogonUser Type9 + Event ID 4648), lateral tool transfer (robocopy UNC), internal spearphishing (SMTP), taint shared content (UNC write), remote session hijacking recon (qwinsta /server:). All fail gracefully on unreachable targets.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
Configurable target host IP (can be unreachable - attempts generate telemetry regardless)
Windows Security Events via AMA in Sentinel for Event ID 4648 (T1550)

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Collection tactic (TA0009). 10 scripts: data from local system (sensitive file search), network share data (UNC recursive listing), data staged (staging dir + bulk copy), screen capture (.NET CopyFromScreen), automated collection (GCI pipeline + Export-Csv), audio capture (Win32_SoundDevice + registry), video capture (WMI PnP + registry), archive collected data (Compress-Archive + GZipStream), email collection (MAPI profile + PST enumeration), clipboard data (Clipboard API). No Admin required. All artefacts auto-cleaned.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
No Administrator privileges required
Display session required for T1113 (screen capture)
Accessible UNC share for T1039 (optional - fails gracefully)

packs.package_name: Excalibur - Command and Control Emulation Pack
packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Command and Control tactic (TA0011). 10 scripts: HTTP C2 beacon (periodic GET + C2 User-Agent), DNS tunneling simulation (random subdomain flood + TXT exfil), encrypted channel (HTTPS cert bypass + RC4 XOR), non-standard port C2 (outbound TCP to Metasploit/Cobalt Strike/Tor/SOCKS ports), protocol tunneling (HTTP CONNECT + DNS-over-HTTPS), dynamic resolution (DGA + fast-flux + dead drop resolver), web service C2 (GitHub/Pastebin/Google API abuse), data obfuscation (cookie encoding + junk padding + browser mimicry), remote access software enum (AnyDesk/TeamViewer/ScreenConnect/ngrok), proxy configuration (netsh winhttp + IE registry). No Admin required. All safe for test environments.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
No Administrator privileges required
Internet access recommended (HTTP/DNS scripts fail gracefully without it but still generate source-side MDE telemetry)
All targets are TEST-NET IPs (RFC 5737) or benign public endpoints - no real C2 infrastructure contacted

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Exfiltration tactic (TA0010). 10 scripts: exfil over C2 channel (HTTP POST with encoded payload, multipart upload, chunked streaming), exfil over alternative protocol (DNS subdomain encoding + alt-port HTTPS), exfil over physical medium (USB/removable drive staging + USBSTOR history), exfil over web service (GitHub API + Pastebin + OneDrive/Graph), automated exfiltration (FileSystemWatcher trigger + auto-POST pipeline), data transfer size limits (chunked POST under DLP threshold), scheduled transfer (schtasks periodic file copy + HTTP POST), transfer to cloud account (Azure Blob + S3 + OneDrive upload simulation), exfil over other network medium (Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/VPN adapter recon), data encrypted before transfer (AES-256 CBC + XOR). No Admin required. All files auto-cleaned.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
No Administrator privileges required
Internet access recommended for HTTP-based exfil scripts (T1041, T1020, T1030, T1022, T1567, T1537). Scripts fail gracefully on isolated machines.
T1029 (Scheduled Transfer) waits 90s during execution for a scheduled run - allow sufficient time

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Impact tactic (TA0040). 10 scripts: data destruction (bulk overwrite with random bytes + rename + delete - NotPetya/Shamoon pattern), ransomware encryption (AES-256 + .encrypted rename + ransom note + RunOnce persistence), service stop (net.exe stop VSS/WinDefend/BITS/wbengine), inhibit system recovery (vssadmin + bcdedit + wbadmin simulation), defacement (HTML file replacement + wallpaper registry), firmware recon (UEFI/BIOS WMI + bcdedit /enum firmware), network DoS (TCP SYN burst + UDP flood to TEST-NET), endpoint DoS (CPU/memory/handle stress, 15s hard limit), system shutdown/reboot (shutdown.exe /r + immediate abort), disk wipe (physical disk enum + diskpart invocation). TEST ENVIRONMENT ONLY. No real data destroyed.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
Most scripts require no Admin. T1490 and T1529 degrade gracefully without admin.
T1498 (Network DoS): target tag MUST be a TEST-NET IP (198.51.100.x) - script has safety check
T1499 (Endpoint DoS): 15-second CPU/memory stress - do NOT run on production
T1489 (Service Stop): VSS/BITS/wbengine are stopped and immediately restarted
TEST ENVIRONMENT ONLY: no real data is destroyed in any script

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Reconnaissance tactic (TA0043). All scripts execute FROM the Morgana agent on a target machine (post-initial-access foothold perspective). 10 scripts: active scanning (TCP port scan 20 ports via .NET sockets - nmap-style from foothold), gather victim network info (DNS deep enum: A/MX/NS/TXT/SOA + AXFR zone transfer attempt + subdomain brute-force), gather victim host info WinPEAS-style (OS/hotfixes/software/services/tasks/shares/autoruns/credential file locations/unquoted paths), gather victim identity info (net.exe user/group + LDAP user enum + Domain Admins + service accounts), search open technical databases (ipinfo.io egress IP + BGP ASN + Shodan/Censys URL construction), search open websites (crt.sh certificate transparency + RDAP WHOIS + GitHub code search + Bing OSINT), gather victim org info (AD domain/DC/forest/trust/OU/GPO enum + Exchange Autodiscover probe), search victim-owned websites (internal web port scan + HTTP header fingerprinting + path enum .git/admin/api), search closed sources (HIBP breach domain API + DeHashed pattern + local breach file search), phishing recon (browser Login Data + cmdkey + klist + SSH keys + PS history credential surface mapping). All read-only.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
No Administrator privileges required
Internet access recommended for T1596/T1593/T1597 OSINT scripts
Domain join recommended for T1589/T1591 LDAP enumeration (graceful fallback on workgroup)
T1595 scan target tag MUST be a TEST-NET IP or lab host you own
All scripts are READ-ONLY: no files created, no config changed

packs.description: Adversary emulation scripts for MITRE ATT&CK Privilege Escalation tactic (TA0004). 10 scripts (11 chains): UAC bypass fodhelper.exe (HKCU ms-settings registry hijack), UAC bypass eventvwr.exe + sdclt.exe (mscfile/exefile hijack), access token manipulation (DuplicateTokenEx + ImpersonateLoggedOnUser P/Invoke + SeImpersonatePrivilege check), scheduled task as SYSTEM (schtasks /ru SYSTEM + PS API SYSTEM principal), exploitation surface enumeration WinPwn-style (PrivEsc CVE patch check + AlwaysInstallElevated + service ACL + kernel drivers), valid accounts (admin group enum + built-in admin + stale accounts + LogonUser API), IFEO debugger hijack (HKLM Image File Execution Options Debugger key + GlobalFlag), DLL search order hijacking surface (writable PATH dirs + phantom DLL + out-of-place DLL loads), Group Policy Modification recon (LDAP GPO ACL + SYSVOL weak perm + DC OU links), escape to host (Docker socket + Hyper-V guest + VMBus pipe detection). UAC bypass scripts auto-clean registry. All artefacts removed by cleanup.
prerequisites: Windows 10/11 or Server 2019/2022 with Morgana agent installed
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint onboarded
No Admin required for most scripts. T1053 (SYSTEM task) and T1546 (IFEO HKLM write) degrade gracefully without admin.
T1548 (UAC bypass): writes to HKCU registry and immediately cleans up. Requires UAC to be set to 'Notify me only when apps try to make changes' (default).
T1134 (token manipulation): P/Invoke token enum and DuplicateTokenEx - no actual impersonation, telemetry only.
Domain join recommended for T1484 (GPO ACL) - degrades gracefully on workgroup.
